messages:
zoe: Heads-up: prepping a social launch for the new Redwood inference benchmark. Aim: dev signups + webinar signups. Need gifs + copy by Thu EOD.

frank: Recommend 3-region cadence: NA morning, EU midday, APAC evening. Different CTAs per region.

mei: CTA plan: NA -> sandbox, EU -> case study, APAC -> webinar. Ill draft longform LinkedIn + 3 X hooks.

luke: Creative can do a 3-frame GIF and 1 hero image by Thu if copy locked Wed. Include a simple cost vs latency visual.

zoe: UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark-launch-29456, utm_medium=social, utm_source={x|linkedin}, utm_content={na|eu|apac}, cv={gif1|gif2}. Luke/deployment team to map leads to SDR queues.

frank: Engagement fallback: if <175 interactions in 24h, boost top node $400 and repost alt hook after 14h. ops-bot, add alert.

ops-bot: Alert created for campaign "benchmark-launch-29456": threshold=175 interactions/24h. Notifying @zoe @frank @mei on trigger.

mei: Draft link: https://drive.google.com/benchmark-launch-draft. I added alt hooks and a customer quote.

zoe: Final checklist: copy (mei) Wed EOD, assets (luke) Thu EOD, UTMs & routing (luke) Thu EOD, schedule Fri AM. Ping if blocked. :rocket:
